# OpenTelemetry registry schema

`schema.json` is an unmodified copy of `data/registry-schema.json` from
[open-telemetry/opentelemetry.io at bb4e55d88ba78a18aa732e40a76cc0066cbab286](https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry.io/blob/bb4e55d88ba78a18aa732e40a76cc0066cbab286/data/registry-schema.json),

(identical to this repository's [LICENSE](../../LICENSE)).

Git blob: `6739cb21360290838a1d6173da212a4f69f4e728`.
SHA-256: `55f2f289418e392678a7d3a16be78868e5da3d1fcd74c510ab8929da998bbfa8`.

The release asset tests validate the entry offline against this pinned schema,
including its ECMAScript lookahead expressions and format assertions.
When updating the schema, replace the complete upstream file and update this
revision and checksum together.
